about.title: A true haven of peace in the heart of Bangui
about.p1: Welcome to Gilmar Residence, a high-end furnished residence for guests looking for total comfort and refinement in Bangui.
about.p2: Our fully equipped apartments welcome you for short or long stays: air-conditioned bedroom, living room, dining area and kitchenette, in a calm and secure setting.
about.p3: On site, enjoy our restaurant-bar, its terrace and our gym. An address designed so you never go without.
about.addressLine: Camp Kassaï, facing Sainte Anne parish — 7th district, Bangui

items.title: Complimentary breakfast
items.desc: For every apartment booked, your first breakfast is on us. Start the day gently.

items.title: Ideal location

cards.name: Living-room Apartment

cards.name: Comfort Room

cards.name: Ambiance Room
